description: OkkMax report for one relay station. Without model: the full report as markdown: rank and score breakdown, station-wide purity, per-channel availability and latency, groups and prices for every model, payment/refund terms and user review summary. With model (and optionally group): a compact JSON result for that one model only: the groups selling it with prices, each group's purity, and whether this model was directly probed in that group (selectedModelDirectlyVerified, actualModelSeen, detectedAt). Station-wide purity does not prove a specific model or group is genuine: when the user cares about one model, pass model. Promotions, invitation codes and invite links are not included. Use the slug from search_stations.

group.description: Group name; only with model. Narrows the result to that one group.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text (statement, reason, notes, suggestions) and of the OkkMax page links. Pass zh when the user writes Chinese, otherwise en. Field names and data values are the same either way.

model.description: Model slug, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5 (from search_models). Returns only this model's groups, prices and purity evidence as JSON. Omit for the full markdown report.

name: get_station
title: Get a relay station report
